description.value: The study used structural MRI gray matter volumes and multivariate SVM-RFE classification to discriminate smokers from nonsmokers, followed by exploratory regressions relating gray matter volume to smoking measures.

spans.text: In this study, we applied VBM along with a multivariate classification method consisting of a support vector machine with recursive feature elimination to discriminate smokers from nonsmokers using their structural MRI data.

description.value: Cross-sectional observational study of smokers and nonsmoking healthy controls.
